findings.title: Nobody reads Audit
findings.message: Orders sends to Audit, but nothing consumes it: messages pile up.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.needsChoice: Pick what reads Audit, then add it and connect queue to it.

findings.title: Orders can't keep up
findings.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 6/s and handles 1/s (600%): its backlog only grows.

fix.label: Set replicas to 11 and Order events partitions to 11 and Returns partitions to 11

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
